summary.plain: The roughly 150 scientists and engineers, from institutes in about eight countries, who built and ran the ANTARES undersea neutrino telescope from 1996 until it was switched off in 2022.
summary.technical: International collaboration (created 1996) operating the ANTARES deep-sea neutrino telescope off Toulon, France; approximately 150 engineers, technicians and physicists per the collaboration's own site.
